description: Canva for realtors on Mac: the desktop app, Brand Kit, flyers, postcards and social posts, plus how Lazur helps you while you design.
intro: Canva for realtors on Mac means using the Canva desktop app to make listing flyers, postcards, door hangers, yard signs and social posts. The Mac app runs on Macs with Intel and Apple chips, so both kinds of Mac can install it. Lazur adds voice help while you work. This guide covers the Canva steps first, then shows where Lazur fits.
tldr: Canva runs as a Mac desktop app on Intel and Apple chips, and it covers most realtor print and social jobs.
Set up a Brand Kit once with your logo, colors, fonts and headshot. One agent guide says Brand Kit is Pro-only, so check plans first.
Check listing numbers and fair housing wording before anything goes to print or to a feed.
Lazur helps you point, guide, dictate and draft inside Canva while you hold Option and Command. It does not click for you.

blocks.text: Canva for realtors on Mac is mostly repeat work. You open a template. You swap in a listing photo, update the price and send the file out. A guide written for agents lists the usual jobs. Flyers, postcards, door hangers, yard signs, newsletters and social posts all show up on that list.
The jobs realtors do most in Canva

items: Listing and open house flyers, plus event flyers
Postcards, bifold brochures, door hangers and yard signs
Newsletters, email templates and email signatures
Social posts, reels and graphics
Listing presentations and infographics
Headshot background removal

blocks.text: Start with the piece you make most often. For many agents that is the listing flyer. Build that template first. Then reuse its layout for the postcard and the door hanger. One good template saves more time than ten rough one-off designs.
Install the Canva Mac app and check the version

Canva's Mac download page says the desktop app runs on Macs with Intel and Apple chips. You can also use Canva in a browser. The desktop app is easier when you move between many files. The page I opened did not list a minimum macOS version, so check that before you install.
Third-party listings show a Canva for Mac build dated Oct 21, 2026. Those pages are not Canva's own release notes. Check the version inside the app instead.

blocks.title: Check the version yourself
blocks.text: Download sites often lag behind the real release. Open the About window from the app menu and look for Canva > About Canva. I could not confirm that label on Canva's help pages, so use whatever About item your menu shows.
Set up a Brand Kit once, then reuse it

A Brand Kit keeps your brand assets in one place. The Close says it stores a logo, colors, fonts, brand voice, photos, graphics and icons. The same guide says Brand Kit is only available on a Pro account. That guide was updated Oct 1, 2025, so confirm plan details yourself.

Build the kit in this order. Add your logo in a full color version and a single color version for dark backgrounds. Add your brand colors next. Pick two fonts, one for headlines and one for body text. Add your headshot and one contact block, so every piece matches.

Brand voice is the part people skip. Write two lines that describe how you sound, such as plain, local and warm. Keep those lines next to your copy notes. Listing copy and social posts then sound like you, even when you write them in a hurry.

rows: Front photo, address line, link or QR code

blocks.text: Remove a headshot background in Canva

Select the headshot, then open Edit image. Go to Effects > Remove background. The Close describes this path and says you can download the cutout with a transparent background. Check the result at close zoom before you export.

Here is a worked example. You shoot a headshot on your phone in front of a cluttered garage wall. You remove the background, place the cutout on a cream postcard, then add your brand color behind it. A sharp photo gives clean edges. A blurry one leaves a rough line around the hair and shoulders.

Two mistakes come up often. The first is a halo of the old background along the hair edge. Zoom in and look before you export. The second is a dark photo. Brighten the original file first, then remove the background, so the edges have more contrast to work with.
Listing flyers and open house sheets, checked before print

Your flyer carries listing data. Price, bedrooms, bathrooms and square footage must match the MLS record. A typo on a printed flyer is hard to take back. Check every number against the source before you print.

Copy needs a second check. NAR's 2026 report says 75% of agents who use AI cite writing listing descriptions as their top AI use. Use a draft to start, then check each claim. Fair housing rules apply to the words you choose, not only the facts.

Read [the fair housing guide for listing copy](/for/realtors/problems/fair-housing-safe-listing-copy) and [how to avoid MLS fines from listing data errors](/for/realtors/problems/avoid-mls-fines-listing-data-errors) for the full checks. Both go deeper than this section can.

Open house sheets carry their own risk. The date and time change for each showing. Keep one master file. Duplicate it for each open house and change only the date line. Pull old sheets from the stack at the door, so nobody reads the wrong time.

items: Price, bedrooms, bathrooms and square footage match the MLS record
Open house date, start time and end time are correct for this file
Photos are yours or licensed for this use, with no other agency logo
Copy describes the home, not the people who might live there
Contact block shows your name, brokerage and license line as your state requires
You printed one proof and read it on paper before the full run

blocks.text: Postcards, door hangers and yard signs

Print pieces fail for three reasons. The text is too small from a distance. The photo is low resolution. The contact details are missing or out of date. Yard signs hit the first problem fast, because drivers only glance at them.

Door hangers need a short message. Use the listing photo, the open house time and one line that says the home is for sale. Put your name and phone number in the same spot on every piece. Neighbors start to recognize a face and a number over time.

blocks.title: Printer specs come first
blocks.text: Canva exports a design, but your printer sets the bleed, the size and the file type they accept. Ask the printer for their file specs before you design. Do not trust a screen preview to show print edges.
Social posts, reels and scheduling in Content Planner

Social media is where many agents look for leads. NAR's 2025 survey found 39% of agents name social media as their top lead-generating tool. Digital ads, business websites and email marketing each came in far lower. Use that to decide where your design time goes.

NAR's 2026 report says 32% of agents use social media scheduling or content tools. The Close says Content Planner is a Pro feature that connects with most major social platforms. Plan a month of posts in one folder, and star the templates you reuse.

Paid promotion has its own rules. If you run housing ads on Meta, read [the Special Ad Category rules for realtors](/for/realtors/problems/meta-housing-ads-special-category) before you boost a flyer. A design that looks fine on a postcard can still need changes for an ad.
Where Lazur fits while you work in Canva

Lazur is a voice assistant for the Mac. It lives in the notch. Hold Option and Command to ask about anything on screen, and Lazur answers out loud. It listens and looks only while you hold the shortcut.

Lazur points at things. Ask where the background remover is, and Lazur draws a circle and a label around it. Ask how to change a flyer into a postcard size, and Lazur guides you one click at a time. It waits for each click before it moves on. It does not click for you.
Lazur is not a plugin or add-in for Canva. It has no partnership with Canva. It works the same way in any app, so the same habit works in Gmail, Google Sheets and your notes.
A real session: flyer for a condo listing

Here is how a short session can go. A condo listing goes live this week, and you need a flyer before a noon meeting. You open the flyer template and hold Option and Command. You ask where the photo editing tools are.

Lazur circles Edit image. You ask for three headline options. Lazur drafts them out loud, and you pick one. You then hold fn and dictate the open house time into the text box, so you do not type it twice.
Last, you check each number against the MLS record yourself. Lazur can see the screen, but you own the data. You also own the wording, so read the final copy aloud before it goes to print.
Name files and folders so you can find them

Most realtors lose time to file names, not design. A folder called Flyers with ten files named final and final2 causes trouble. Name each file with the street, the piece and the version. Keep one folder per listing, and one subfolder for print and one for social.

items: Use a street name and piece type, such as oak-street-flyer-v2
Keep the print proof and the final file in the same folder
Star the master template in the folder, so the team finds it fast
Delete old open house versions only after the new one prints

blocks.text: Canva Glow Up slowdown reports on Mac

A blog dated Oct 19, 2026 reports that the newer Canva editor, called Glow Up, uses more RAM and feels less responsive. It also says some tools moved behind extra menus. The author relies on unnamed user reports and did no testing of their own.

Treat that as a lead, not a finding. If Canva feels slow on your Mac, open Applications > Utilities > Activity Monitor. Check the Memory tab while you work. Close large apps before a big edit, and restart Canva if a file keeps stalling.
Keep a copy of your slowest design. When an update changes how things feel, you can test the same file again. That tells you more than a forum thread does.
Costs, plan limits and what Lazur adds

Canva's free plan has limits, and The Close says so without listing them. The guide places Brand Kit and Content Planner on the Pro side. I could not load Canva's pricing page, so I have no verified price to quote. Check Canva's pricing page before you buy.

Lazur starts with a trial that needs no credit card. Plans are on the [pricing page](/pricing). Dictation is unlimited on both paid plans, so you can dictate captions and notes without watching a counter.
Mistakes realtors make in Canva on Mac
Most of these mistakes come from a skipped check, not from a lack of skill.

items: Designing a flyer at the wrong size, then finding out at the printer
Keeping three logo files, so the wrong one lands on a yard sign
Copying an old open house date into a new template
Using a dark or cropped headshot that looks off in print
Pasting AI listing copy without checking each claim
Leaving the contact block off the back of a postcard

blocks.text: A listing launch week in Canva
This plan covers one listing. Adjust it to your brokerage's approval steps. The order matters more than the exact days.

items: Monday: duplicate the master flyer, then update price, address and photos
Tuesday: check every number against the MLS record and print one proof
Wednesday: build the postcard and door hanger from the same listing photo
Thursday: export social graphics and schedule them in Content Planner if you have Pro
Friday: review what printed and what posted, then log the open house date

blocks.text: Privacy when Lazur looks at your screen

Lazur listens and looks only while you hold the shortcut. Audio and the screenshot go to AI providers so Lazur can answer you. They are not stored. Content is never used to train AI models. Lazur keeps a memory of what you asked and did on your Mac.
Client data is the real risk. Before you hold Option and Command, close any file or tab that shows a seller's details or a buyer's financing. Then ask your question.
Start with Canva, then add Lazur

Start with one template and one Brand Kit. Build the listing flyer first, then copy its layout for the other pieces. When that feels routine, add voice help. Download Lazur from [the download page](/download). For a wider view of design work, read [Canva for designers on Mac](/for/designers/canva). For email signatures and replies, see [Gmail for realtors on Mac](/for/realtors/gmail).

faq.question: Is Canva for realtors on Mac a desktop app?
faq.answer: Yes. Canva's Mac download page says the desktop app runs on Macs with Intel and Apple chips. You can also use Canva in a browser. The page I opened did not list a minimum macOS version, so check it before you install.

faq.question: Do I need Canva Pro for realtor work?
faq.answer: Some useful pieces sit on Pro. The Close says Brand Kit is only available on a Pro account, and it calls Content Planner a Pro feature. Compare plans on Canva's pricing page before you decide.

faq.question: Can Canva remove a headshot background on a Mac?
faq.answer: Yes. The Close describes the path as Edit image > Effects > Remove background. Use the sharpest photo you have, and check the hair edges before you export.

faq.question: Does Lazur edit my Canva design for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur points at controls, guides you one click at a time and drafts text out loud. It does not click buttons or change your files in Canva.

faq.question: Does Lazur connect to Canva?
faq.answer: No. Lazur is not a plugin or add-in for Canva, and it has no partnership with Canva. It is a voice assistant on your Mac that works across apps.

faq.question: Is it safe to let Lazur see client details?
faq.answer: Lazur listens and looks only while you hold Option and Command. Audio and the screenshot go to AI providers to answer you and are not stored. Close client files before you ask, anyway.

faq.question: Why does Canva feel slow on my Mac?
faq.answer: A blog dated Oct 19, 2026 reports slowdowns in the newer editor, based on unnamed user reports. Open Activity Monitor to check memory use, close large apps, and keep Canva updated.
